name: Render Lifestyle GP
summary: Agrega personas y vida cotidiana a un render terminado de casa GP, para material de marketing aspiracional.

source.notes: Template app written by tools/template_apps.py: the workflow is apps/edit's (built by tools/build_apps.py); the prompt below is fixed and "Extra direction" is appended to it.

inputs.label: Render terminado o foto de casa
Personas
inputs.default: a young couple in their late twenties

options.value: a young couple in their late twenties
options.label: Pareja joven

options.value: a Mexican family with two young children aged 6 and 9
options.label: Familia con 2 niños

options.value: a multigenerational Mexican family with grandparents, parents and two children
options.label: Familia multigeneracional

options.value: a woman in her thirties with a medium-sized friendly dog
options.label: Mujer sola con perro

inputs.label: Escena
inputs.default: standing at the front entrance, smiling and waving at the viewer

options.value: standing at the front entrance, smiling and waving at the viewer
options.label: En la entrada saludando

options.value: playing together on the front driveway
options.label: Jugando frente a casa

options.value: walking up to the home together
options.label: Caminando hacia la casa

options.value: unloading moving boxes from a car in the driveway, looking excited
options.label: Mudanza (cajas, ilusión)

options.value: gathered on the front patio sharing a meal around a small table
options.label: En el patio compartiendo

inputs.label: Momento del día
inputs.default: at golden hour with warm sunset light

options.value: at golden hour with warm sunset light
options.label: Atardecer dorado

options.value: in the morning with bright soft daylight
options.label: Mañana luminosa

options.value: at night with the home's warm interior lights glowing
options.label: Noche con luces cálidas

options.value: elegant aspirational mood with cinematic composition
options.label: Aspiracional elegante

options.value: dynamic candid mood with light motion and natural laughter
options.label: Dinámico (movimiento)

inputs.label: Extra direction
inputs.help: Added at the end of the app's prompt.

bind.template: Add life to the architectural rendering in <ref_image_0>: a photorealistic lifestyle photograph of the same home with {people} {scene}, {time}, {mood}, no architectural changes to the home itself, keep the facade, materials, windows and lot exactly as in the reference, professional lifestyle real-estate photography, high detail, ultra-realistic. {details}
